q: The period of the limit cycle born in a Hopf bifurcation at ω = ω₀ is approximately:
opts: 2π/ω₀ + O(μ) for small bifurcation parameter μ
exp: The limit cycle period near a Hopf bifurcation is 2π/ω₀ + O(μ), where ω₀ is the imaginary part of the critical eigenvalue. The frequency correction O(μ) comes from the nonlinear terms (the b in the normal form θ̇ = ω₀ + b·r²).
